checks.name: execution_registry_and_client_regression
checks.result: 11 checks passed plus 3 repeated first-registration concurrency checks; two owned child fixture entrypoints were invoked explicitly.

acceptance.criterion: 运行任务在执行前持久登记，绑定项目、工作、会话、执行器与唯一操作标识。
受管本地命令记录启动/结束、退出码及日志产物；调用会话退出后仍可查询结果。
相同操作标识不会重复执行；外部任务只登记可验证引用，不因 PID 存在或调用者声称成功认定完成。

limitations: At-most-once dispatch; interrupted dispatch and missing supervisors are not automatically restarted.
The supervisor observes its direct child, not arbitrary background descendants.
External executions are references without a verified outcome.
Owned local CLI checks are not E4 or a registry release.
